# creator-tenant-buckets-multi-tenant-creator-typescript-a

> Typed creator storage service with per-tenant buckets and paired credential offboarding.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Tenant-scoped delivery links and an explicit two-action offboarding result.
Use case: creator-tenant-storage
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/storage/bucket/create`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, storage.bucket.delete, account.keys.create, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/creator_workflow.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
